description:
The ultimate anti-hero has arrived. This custom **Shego Katarina** skin transforms the Sinister Blade into Dr. Drakken's formidable partner in crime. With her iconic green flame powers and deadly agility, you'll feel the ruthless precision of **Shego** as you blink through enemies and leave a trail of chaos and sass. This is the ultimate skin for players who want to dominate with style and a touch of mischief.
